technique_name: Discuss the potential implications of the given COVID-19 vaccine on international trade.
description: The development of a COVID-19 vaccine has the potential to result in a positive impact on international trade. As countries work to vaccinate their populations, demand for essential goods should increase. This can lead to improvements in production and make it easier for countries to resume normal levels of international trade.
